overview_description.description: Litnerd brings the creator economy to traditional K-12 education. Litnerd offers a cohort based reading and SEL program where performers bring books to life, turning classrooms into immersive experiences. Litnerd is a contracted vendor with the New York City Department of Education and they're currently serving over 14,000 students.  Litnerd's goal is to help students fall in love with learning through storytelling and to provide the highest quality resources for students and teachers.

about_short_description.short_description: Litnerd brings the creator economy to traditional K-12 education, offering a cohort based reading and SEL program to schools.

product.name: Litnerd Reading Club
product.description: An online reading program combining weekly live meetups, gamified reading tasks, and multimedia content to build reading skills in K-5 students.

product.name: Litnerd Reading Club Tournament
product.description: A competitive reading program where students earn rewards by reading daily, completing literacy tasks, and participating in live events.

product.name: Litnerd Curriculum
product.description: A standards-aligned literacy curriculum based on the Science of Reading, covering phonics, phonemic awareness, vocabulary, comprehension, and fluency.

product.name: Litnerd Tutoring
product.description: One-on-one reading intervention sessions with qualified teachers, customized to each child's needs and supported by the Litnerd reading app.

product.name: Litnerd App and Family Portal
product.description: A digital platform for reading, gamification, progress tracking, and family engagement in literacy development.
